caption: The drawing depicts a lace collar in a wide, rounded U-shape with a slightly squared inner edge. The collar is intricately detailed with dense patterns of swirling vines, leaves, and numerous small five-petaled flowers. The lace work includes both solid embroidered areas and open mesh-like sections, creating a textured yet airy appearance. The primary colors in the drawing are shades of white, gray, and black, which are used to convey the three-dimensional qualities and texture of the lace. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the elaborate design of the collar. The lower right of the drawing features a small printed or written signature, "W. W. JENNINGS."
title: Lace Collar
